thread:
Mia Nguyen: quick question — thinking about adding a persistent "Tool Explorer" to the left of the Playground run pane. current mock has it as a collapsible drawer. thoughts on discoverability vs noise?
Sam Ortiz: I like a thin docked panel (like 240px). surfacing function defs and examples helps discoverability. but worried about vertical space on smaller screens.
Raj Patel: +1 for docked. maybe make it responsive: docked on >=1280px, overlay on smaller. also keyboard shortcut to toggle (e.g., `Ctrl+\`) so power users can hide it.
Alex Chen: accessibility note — if it's overlay on small screens, ensure focus trap and restore focus to the toggle when closed. aria-hidden when collapsed.
Mia Nguyen: good call. also copy: currently the header says "Tools" which felt vague in testing. alternatives: "Tool Explorer", "Functions & Schemas", "Invokable Tools"?
Sam Ortiz: "Functions & Schemas" is explicit but long. "Tool Explorer" feels modern. testers liked "Explore tools" microcopy under header.
Raj Patel: we ran 6 sessions — people expected examples first. propose top of panel = search, pinned examples, then file-like list of functions with small signature.
Alex Chen: UI nit: add a 1px divider and decrease default font-size in list to 13px so the body of the playground doesn't get pushed. Also ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for labels.
Mia Nguyen: UX flow question — should the run history show which tool variants were used per invocation? e.g., "invoke: translate_v2 (quantized)" in timeline.
Sam Ortiz: yes please. makes debugging regressions easier. but privacy consideration: names could leak. add a hover detail that reveals variant, otherwise show general label.
Raj Patel: implementation idea: store an anonymized id in run metadata and map to human label only in UI if the user has access. backend already has variant ids in trace logs.
Alex Chen: keyboard nav within Tool Explorer: up/down to move, Enter opens signature, Space queues tool into prompt composer. we should add live region announcements when a tool is queued: "Tool queued: summarize_text" for screen readers.
Mia Nguyen: can we keep the function def editor minimized by default? testers said long schemas distract during quick tries. maybe collapsed with a 1-click "edit schema" that expands inline.
Sam Ortiz: collapse-by-default is fine. but add a small badge when function def has validation errors: red dot + tooltip "schema errors".
Raj Patel: quick code suggestion for accessible toggle button semantics:

```
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="tool-explorer-panel" id="tool-explorer-toggle">Tools</button>
<nav id="tool-explorer-panel" aria-hidden="true">...</nav>
```

When opening set `aria-expanded=true` and remove `aria-hidden`.
Alex Chen: also ensure the panel obeys reduced-motion: `prefers-reduced-motion` should disable slide animations.
Mia Nguyen: copy tweak for run history: change "Replay" to "Replay invocation" in a11y tests — some users thought it was video replay.
Sam Ortiz: small layout ask — make function signature line wrap gracefully and show an inline `...` menu on hover for quick actions: add to prompt, view schema, view examples.
Raj Patel: backend note — we should add a `tool_usage_hint` field in the invocation metadata so UI can show recommended inputs; simple string. will file an infra task.
Mia Nguyen: thanks. last thing — analytics: track if people pin a tool from explorer; that will tell us whether the panel should be default-open.

Alex Chen: leaving a tiny prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/tool-explorer-proto — comments invited, especially on keyboard flow.
Sam Ortiz: I'll prototype the collapsed function editor and the red-dot error badge today.
Raj Patel: I'll add the `tool_usage_hint` field to the trace schema and drop a PR by EOD.
Mia Nguyen: perfect — followups: Sam/UI implement prototype, Raj/backend schema, Alex/accessibility checklist. cc @Product for priorities. thanks all! :rocket:
